item.title: How open source strikes the right balance between social and market norms
item.description: Lately, I’ve been knocking off a few books that have accumulated on my “must-read” list. One of my favourites came recommended by my technical sales professor at SAIT, “Predictably Irrational, by Dan Ariely. It’s a New York Times bestseller. It was recommended based on its insights around behavioural science, specifically what factors influence a buyer’s decision making. And it reads quite satisfactorily for that. However, as a linux enthusiast, there’s one particular chapter that stood out to me.
